title: Allergy checks miss ingredient families and incomplete recipes
steps: Add a child with milk allergy. Pick paneer/curd/oats as frequent dishes and open Today. Separately check aloo paratha against a wheat allergy.
actual: Paneer roll, curd rice and oats porridge are allowed; aloo paratha is allowed for wheat allergy. Today labels paneer/curd as fitting everyone's rules.
expected: Resolve milk→paneer/curd/cheese and wheat→atta/bread; block all dishes containing the allergen. Unknown ingredient metadata must not be presented as proven safe.
fix: Use canonical ingredient/allergen metadata, synonym mapping and complete component recipes; fail safely for unknown ingredients.

title: Spice tolerance is treated as a soft preference
steps: Set a member's spice tolerance to None; check chole_rice with spice 2.
actual: The hard rule returns ok=true; ranking only subtracts a score.
expected: The FSD lists spice tolerance among hard per-member rules; a hotter dish requires an explicitly safe variant.
fix: Filter by maximum spice or model a mild variant instead of relying on ranking penalties.

title: Unknown custom dishes are automatically labelled vegetarian
steps: Add Chicken soup as an unknown/custom dish and inspect its metadata.
actual: It is saved as diet=veg with empty ingredients/allergens, so it can enter vegetarian recommendations.
expected: An unknown dish remains unclassified until the user supplies dietary and ingredient metadata.
fix: Require diet and allergen confirmation for custom dishes and exclude incomplete dishes from safety-sensitive recommendations.

title: Every vegan household receives an empty menu
steps: Set the only eater's diet to Vegan; request breakfast, lunch and dinner.
actual: All three result lists are empty. No catalogue dish is tagged vegan.
expected: The supported vegan setting has usable safe catalogue options.
fix: Audit catalogue diet tags, explicitly distinguish vegan preparations and supply adequate options in every slot.

title: Manual plan changes and swaps bypass hard rules
steps: In a vegetarian household, open Tomorrow → Change dinner, remove current choices, search chicken, select Chicken curry with rice, save and Confirm all. Calendar swaps also send options straight to upsertPlan.
actual: Chicken is saved in the vegetarian household's week without warning. Search and swaps do not validate member/date/slot rules.
expected: Every planning path enforces diet, allergy, fasting, portable-box fit and slot validity.
fix: Validate at the shared plan mutation boundary and filter planning pickers by full context; validate both destinations before swapping.

title: Cook's selected alternate is not reflected in tomorrow/week drafts
steps: Plan rajma/chole/dal, apply the cook's selection of chole, then generate draftDay or reopen Tomorrow/Week.
actual: The row still starts with rajma because it uses options[0], ignoring chosenDishId. Regenerated Cook Cards likewise use the original first choice.
expected: All views show the selected dish consistently while retaining alternates.
fix: Resolve the effective selected dish centrally and preserve it across drafts and Cook Card generation.

title: Changing an already cooked plan preserves cooked status with a different menu
steps: Plan rajma, log it as cooked, then replace the plan with chole through upsertPlan.
actual: The plan remains cooked but its options become chole and chosenDishId is cleared, while history still records rajma.
expected: Editing a completed meal follows an explicit correction flow and updates linked history, or is refused.
fix: Define valid status transitions and prevent a menu edit from silently mutating a completed plan.

title: Manual meal correction cannot replace a previous cook pick
steps: Set a plan's chosenDishId to rajma; manually log chole for the same date/slot.
actual: History records chole, but the plan retains rajma due to the null-coalescing assignment.
expected: A confirmed manual correction becomes the authoritative cooked dish.
fix: Update the linked selected dish when logging a confirmed correction.

title: Split plates lose group membership and overcount main-plate portions
steps: Create one ordinary eater and two Wednesday-fasting eaters; build Wednesday lunch rows and Cook payload.
actual: The second plate retains only the first fasting member ID. Main-plate quantities are multiplied by all three eaters; the special plate is sized for one.
expected: Each plate retains all its eater IDs; portions exclude other plates and account for age.
fix: Persist forMemberIds arrays and compute per-plate adult-equivalent portions.

title: Saved tiffin choices can repeat breakfast or the other box
steps: Save poha for breakfast and a short-break shortlist containing poha as an alternate; generate the day plan.
actual: The saved shortlist still contains poha. Newly generated primaries differ, but persisted and edited alternatives are not checked.
expected: Approved choices and subsequent selections preserve the distinctness of breakfast and both boxes.
fix: Revalidate the complete pair when any option changes or a cook selects an alternate.

title: A breakfast log consumes leftovers that were created later that day
steps: Record leftover dal from Wednesday dinner; then backfill Wednesday breakfast with dal paratha.
actual: The dinner leftover is marked resolved by the earlier breakfast.
expected: Only meals occurring after leftover creation can consume it.
fix: Compare date plus slot/time, not date alone.

title: Restaurant meals are counted as reuse of household leftovers
steps: Record leftover dal yesterday; log ordered-in dal paratha today.
actual: The leftover is marked used and a transformation decision is recorded.
expected: A restaurant order cannot prove that food at home was reused.
fix: Ask about actual leftover consumption and exclude ordered-in entries from automatic resolution.

title: A purchased cart item is suppressed from future grocery suggestions
steps: Add paneer to the cart, mark it bought, and plan another paneer meal.
actual: The previous done item suppresses paneer indefinitely until bought items are manually cleared.
expected: A new need can reappear without deleting previous purchase records.
fix: Deduplicate only open items within the relevant plan/time window.

title: Shopping list omits core ingredients present only in quantities
steps: Empty staples and plan dal tadka with roti.
actual: Missing items contain onion/tomato but omit dal and atta, which exist only in quantity metadata.
expected: All required non-staple ingredients appear in the list.
fix: Use a single complete ingredient model for shopping, allergy checks and portion quantities.

title: Only known still recommends never-cooked dishes
steps: Set adventurous=0 and make only rajma known; request three dinner suggestions.
actual: Novel dishes still appear. The dial changes a score penalty rather than the eligible novelty count.
expected: Only known excludes novel dishes, or the product explicitly changes the promise and specification.
fix: Apply the novelty quota during candidate selection and define a visible fallback when too few known dishes fit.

title: Pause learning still adapts to new meal logs
steps: Pause learning, record yesterday's rajma, and compare its dinner score before and after.
actual: Recency and known/novelty signals still change its score; only selected signals are paused.
expected: The UI promise that suggestions stop adapting to logged meals matches the implemented pause scope.
fix: Freeze adaptive inputs or explicitly clarify which safety/recency signals remain active while paused.

title: Feedback leaks between short-break and lunch tiffin boxes
steps: Give poha a Full return in the child's lunch box, then score poha for the short-break box.
actual: A negative T driver is added to the other box, despite no short-break rejection.
expected: Tiffin return signals are learned per child and per box.
fix: Require matching child and box when aggregating tiffin acceptance.

title: Safe choice badge can mean eight neutral logs with no positive feedback
steps: Log rajma eight times with no reactions; read favourites.
actual: The dish earns safe=true, while the screen describes it as loved again and again.
expected: Repeated positive outcomes support the badge; mere logging is not evidence of love or dietary safety.
fix: Track positive-outcome counts separately and distinguish preference confidence from allergen safety.

title: Negated preferences are inverted
steps: Write No millets please or Avoid sweets in Preferences.
actual: The parser assigns positive millet/sweet weights. The UI previews more millets for No millets please.
expected: Negation decreases the relevant preference, preserving the user's meaning.
fix: Handle negation and scope before keyword weights; keep previews editable.

title: Hindi-script voice transcripts are not parsed by the offline parser
steps: Parse कल रात खिचड़ी with today's date 2026-10-07.
actual: Dish matching strips non-Latin text; Hindi date/slot words are not detected. The result lacks khichdi and yesterday's date.
expected: The promised Hindi/on-device flow recognises dish, date and slot without requiring the optional paid service.
fix: Use Unicode-aware normalization and Indic aliases/date/slot vocabulary; test real dictation outputs.

title: Distinct Indic custom dish names collide on the same ID
steps: Create custom dishes खिचड़ी and पापड़.
actual: Both IDs become custom_ because the ID normalization discards every character.
expected: Different names produce unique stable dish IDs in every supported script.
fix: Generate opaque IDs and retain Unicode names separately; deduplicate on normalized name only when intended.

title: Cook's Change request changes no persistent state
steps: Apply a Change reply to an existing meal.
actual: A temporary note appears but the family state is byte-for-byte unchanged; there is no actionable request, alternate prompt or learning event.
expected: The planner receives a persistent change request with two alternates and the outcome can influence learning.
fix: Persist cook responses, surface unresolved change requests and record the appropriate recommendation outcome.

title: Cook reply card ID is ignored and unknown meal IDs can add items
steps: Paste WC:wrongcard with a current plan ID and rank=2. Separately supply Missing items against an unknown plan ID.
actual: The wrong-card reply selects curd rice and adds groceries; unknown meal IDs also create cart items. STOP is not bound to a specific cook/card.
expected: Validate card, family, cook, expiration and meal membership before mutating state.
fix: Authenticate cook-response records and reject mismatches/replays; do not imply that the local paste screen is remotely exploitable without planner action.

title: Cook links are unsigned, unexpired editable payloads
steps: Generate a Cook page link; decode the base64url fragment.
actual: The entire menu, member names and reply phone are client-controlled JSON. Neither generator nor Cook page validates a signature, expiry or revocation.
expected: A signed, expiring token controls access and integrity; base64 encoding is not authentication.
fix: Use a backend-validated token with expiration/revocation and minimal payload disclosure.

title: A family custom fast applies to a member with only a no-meat rule
steps: Add a custom Wednesday fast date; give a member only a Tuesday no-nonveg rule.
actual: The member is treated as fasting on Wednesday because any dayRules entry qualifies.
expected: Custom fasts are assigned to specific members and must not convert unrelated rules into fasting.
fix: Associate custom calendar overrides with member/rule IDs and distinguish dietary exclusions from fasts.

title: Malformed reminder times are silently accepted
steps: Enter abc or 25:90 as a reminder/pickup time and update reminders.
actual: abc becomes 00:00; out-of-range values reach the scheduling API. UI callers suppress resulting errors.
expected: Reject invalid HH:MM values visibly before saving or scheduling.
fix: Validate hour/minute ranges, retain the last valid setting and report permission/scheduling failures.

title: Short-break box accepts wet meals without box-fit validation
steps: Check idli_sambar for tiffin_short.
actual: The dish is allowed solely because portable=true and T is listed; its sambar is not dry finger food.
expected: Short-break boxes enforce small/dry/finger-food suitability separately from lunch portability.
fix: Use explicit short-break/lunch box-fit metadata and validate it in every planning path.

title: Pickup reminder arithmetic clamps instead of carrying minutes
steps: Set pickup to 15:50 and inspect the scheduled weekly trigger.
actual: It is 15:59 rather than the implementation's intended pickup+15=16:05.
expected: Honor the specified pickup timing policy with correct clock arithmetic.
fix: Add minutes through a date/time utility; clarify whether FSD pickup itself or a configurable delay is intended.

title: Updating one family cancels all scheduled notifications
steps: Schedule reminders for family A and a Cook Card; update a member or reminders in family B.
actual: scheduleFamilyReminders invokes global cancellation, removing reminders belonging to other families and outstanding Cook Cards.
expected: Only the relevant family's replaced reminders are cancelled.
fix: Persist notification IDs by family and purpose and cancel them selectively.

title: Tiffin notifications ignore school holidays
steps: Add a Wednesday holiday for a child who attends Wednesdays; schedule reminders.
actual: The weekly Wednesday tiffin trigger is still scheduled and cannot skip the recorded holiday.
expected: No return check for school holidays or days without a packed box.
fix: Schedule date-aware child/box checks and refresh upcoming notifications when calendars change.

title: Children with both tiffin boxes disabled still get return reminders
steps: Keep school information but turn off Short-break box and Lunch box; schedule reminders.
actual: Weekly tiffin checks still exist because box flags are ignored.
expected: No box means no box-return notification.
fix: Filter by enabled boxes and planned/logged tiffins.

title: Cook reminder does not check whether the card was already sent
steps: Set tomorrow's plans to sent and schedule a Cook reminder before its configured time.
actual: A reminder is created anyway. Returned notification IDs are discarded, and the send flow never cancels it.
expected: The reminder is conditional on an unsent card and is cancelled after sending.
fix: Keep per-card notification IDs and reconcile them on plan/send state changes.

title: No 9 pm digest for unconfirmed auto-logged meals
steps: Create an unconfirmed auto-log entry and schedule family notifications.
actual: Only a generic tomorrow-plan notification and tiffin reminders are created. No exception digest is implemented.
expected: At 9 pm, list unconfirmed meals and ask only about exceptions.
fix: Implement a date-aware digest linked to the pending entries, with an accessible confirmation/correction flow.

title: Cook reply phone is missing the country code
steps: Use the onboarding-supported ten-digit Indian planner number and build a Cook payload.
actual: The payload retains ten digits, while docs/cook.html passes them straight into wa.me. The app's separate WhatsApp helper adds 91 correctly.
expected: Both outgoing and reply destinations use validated international digits.
fix: Use one shared E.164 normalization contract for the app and Cook page. Actual WhatsApp delivery was not attempted.

title: Cook Cards ignore the cook's working days
steps: Add QA Cook, scheduled Tuesday lunch only. Confirm Sunday 4 October's meals.
actual: A Sunday lunch Cook Card is generated. An empty cookSlots list also falls back to all slots.
expected: Only on-duty dates/slots produce that cook's cards; an explicitly empty schedule is not all-day availability.
fix: Resolve the cook on duty using days, slots and leave before offering or sending the card.

title: Opening WhatsApp immediately marks meals sent
steps: Tap Send on WhatsApp, then leave or cancel the WhatsApp composer without sending.
actual: Source marks planned meals sent immediately after opening the external URL, with no actual-send confirmation or acknowledgement.
expected: Opening a composer must not be presented as confirmed delivery.
fix: Represent prepared/opened separately from user-confirmed sent and use cook acknowledgements to establish receipt.

title: Auto-log only runs on hydration or foreground transition
steps: Leave the app foregrounded across a meal slot end, or switch to another local family with overdue plans.
actual: No timer/job or active-family dependency invokes autoLog at the slot boundary. Its pure function passes, but the workflow can remain stale until a later foreground/restart.
expected: Accepted meals become logs at slot end and the active family's pending state stays current.
fix: Reconcile on slot boundaries, family switches and notification/digest generation, with a durable background strategy where supported.

title: Logging can lose the tiffin or split-plate member
steps: With two school children, type a tiffin entry and Save without picking a child; or follow Log as cooked on a member-specific split plate.
actual: Save only requires a dish. withKid assigns a child only when there is exactly one, and the Today Log link passes no member/plan ID. Entries can become family-wide and leave the intended plan unclosed.
expected: Child/plate identity is mandatory and preserved from the source plan.
fix: Pass member/plan identifiers in links and validate required identity before saving tiffin/split-plate entries.

title: Deleting a family does not delete retained native photos
steps: Log a native meal photo, then delete its family.
actual: The deletion removes the JSON record only. keepPhoto copies files into the shared documents/photos folder; neither family nor meal deletion removes them.
expected: Delete includes the associated photos and exported/cache artifacts within the promised scope.
fix: Track media ownership and remove unreferenced files safely; test deletion with actual native files. No real family was deleted during this audit.

title: Common controls are below the FSD touch-target size and inputs lack programmatic labels
evidence: Source + browser accessibility tree; native TalkBack pending
steps: Inspect small buttons/chips/toggles and labelled form inputs in the shared UI kit.
actual: Small buttons/chips specify 36 dp, toggles 44 dp, and Input renders label text without accessibilityLabel/labelledBy. Browser textbox names are blank.
expected: 48 dp interactive targets and labels that screen readers can associate with controls.
fix: Enforce target sizes centrally, connect labels and test keyboard, TalkBack, VoiceOver and large-font flows.

title: Selecting an alternate retains the first dish's ingredient quantities
steps: Open the synthetic Hindi Cook page for rajma/curd rice/aloo paratha and select Curd rice.
actual: Curd rice is selected but the page still shows rajma (soak overnight) ½ cup, rice 1 cup.
expected: Quantities match the selected dish and assigned eaters.
fix: Provide quantities per ranked option and resolve them using the selected index.

title: Cook language changes headings but not dish names or quantity instructions
steps: Set the cook language to Hindi and create/open a Cook Card.
actual: Headings use Hindi, but Rajma chawal, Curd rice, Aloo paratha, soak overnight and units remain English. The catalogue has no per-language name model.
expected: The complete operational card, including dish names, quantities and preparation instructions, is understandable in the cook's language/script.
fix: Add language-aware catalogue and ingredient/quantity strings and have native speakers verify all launch languages.

title: Recorded swipe/accept events do not feed later ranking
steps: Record twenty negative swipe events for a known rajma suggestion; compare its later score.
actual: The score is unchanged. Ranking never reads family.events, despite storing the events.
expected: Accepted/swiped outcomes influence the intended learning signals or the FSD is explicitly revised.
fix: Aggregate context-aware recommendation outcomes with decay and regression-test learning from actual decisions.

title: Top-three suggestions do not enforce the specified diversity
steps: Request three lunch options for the unconstrained general catalogue fixture.
actual: Only two distinct bases appear although rice, roti and other candidates exist; the algorithm accepts a different base OR main group within a score window.
expected: Meet the FSD's base and main-group diversity, or document the fallback when the catalogue cannot satisfy both.
fix: Select with explicit diversity constraints and make a principled, visible fallback for constrained households.
